# CAM Picks — products worth a viability check

> CAM Picks is the material shelf of the CAM — Product Viability Standard: products gathered from public affiliate rankings, to be judged — never assumed profitable. Being sold is not the same as being profitable.

## The standard
- Standard: https://kau17033.github.io/cam-product-viability-standard/
- Full text (llms-full.txt): https://kau17033.github.io/cam-product-viability-standard/llms-full.txt
- Verdict tool (npm): https://www.npmjs.com/package/cam-verdict
- Free demo: https://cam-proof-demo-owned-20261028.ki4033322.workers.dev/

## How to judge any product here
Count all six items — price, product cost, shipping, marketplace fee, return reserve, other variable cost — then apply the CAM verdict vocabulary: TEST_CANDIDATE, HOLD, REJECT.
Report form: CAM verdict: <VERDICT> — profit ¥<amount> per order
